instruction: Write an XDP program that implements 1:1 Source NAT (SNAT) using a BPF hash map 'snat_table'. Lookup source IP; if a mapped IP exists, rewrite ip->saddr, update IPv4 checksum, and return XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define BPF hash map 'snat_table' mapping internal IP (__u32) to external IP (__u32)
Rewrite ip->saddr with mapped IP and update ip->check
Strictly validate Ethernet and IPv4 header boundaries

tests.name: test_snat_rewrite_pass
tests.description: Internal packet from 192.168.1.45 should be SNAT rewritten and passed

tests.name: test_tcp_snat_pass
tests.description: Internal TCP packet from 192.168.1.45 should be SNAT rewritten and passed

tests.name: test_truncated_pass
tests.description: Truncated Ethernet frame header should pass with XDP_PASS
